sentences.text: No: for a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges.

The broader rule for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 allows pre-payment charges only in cases other than the business-purpose individual and MSE categories covered above, and then only as per the approved policy of a UCB.
For term loans, that policy-based levy is based on the amount being prepaid, but that point does not override the ban that applies here.
